comment: Settings of the unofficial test builds (Windows x64 and macOS arm64), read by .github/scripts/release-package.mjs. minOfficialVersion is the official OpenTune release that must be installed on the machine (it provides the models and, on Windows, D3D12Core.dll); the side-car smoke test of prerelease.yml installs this version too (olderInstallers in .github/e2e/official-install.json), unpacks the package next to it and runs it, so a version that no longer works fails the build. The macos section is the same for the macOS package: minOfficialVersion is the oldest official macOS release the smoke test passed with, bundleName / bundleIdentifier are written into the Info.plist of the renamed app bundle.
